biotools.summary: Coordinate-based genomic visualization package for R. It grants users the ability to programmatically produce complex, multi-paneled figures. Tailored for genomics, plotgardener allows users to visualize large complex genomic datasets and provides exquisite control over how plots are placed and arranged on a page.
